text: Si tawno no woodannoo tooñirɓe sirko e geddi ɓen, kala ko woni kon ka leydi, immorde e jawle, ɓe sottorayno ɗum, lepte saɗtuɗe ɗen ɗe yi'oyta, ɓaawo ummital maɓɓe. Kono ɓe alaa feere ɗum. Hay si ɓe heɓu feere mun, ɓe jaɓanoytaake. Ontuma, feeñirana ɓe ka Allah, noone e lepte, ɗo ɓe tijjanooki.
